GenAI Engineer Roles & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Agents.
Develop enterprise-grade GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, LangChain/LangGraph, and other AI/ML frameworks.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines including document ingestion, preprocessing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking, and response generation.
Work with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Azure AI Search, and PostgreSQL/pgvector for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Develop prompt engineering strategies including system prompts, few-shot prompting, structured outputs, and prompt optimization.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications, REST APIs, databases, and external/internal tools using function calling and tool-based workflows.
Design and implement AI Agents capable of reasoning, tool selection, task execution, and multi-step workflow orchestration.
Develop APIs and backend services using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask.
Evaluate and improve LLM and RAG performance based on accuracy, relevance, hallucination rate, latency, and cost.
Implement LLM evaluation frameworks, test datasets, monitoring, logging, and performance metrics for production GenAI applications.
Work with cloud-based AI services including Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI, AWS, or Google Cloud for deploying scalable GenAI solutions.
Implement responsible AI, security, and governance practices including data privacy, access control, prompt-injection protection, and prevention of sensitive-data leakage.
Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, architects, business teams, and clients to understand requirements and translate business problems into scalable AI solutions.
Participate in solution architecture, proof-of-concepts (PoCs), technical design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Optimize LLM applications for scalability, performance, token consumption, response time, and infrastructure cost.
Stay updated with emerging technologies in Generative AI, LLMs, multimodal AI, AI Agents, model fine-tuning, and enterprise AI.
Contribute to technical documentation, code reviews, development standards, and best practices for GenAI solutions.

Key Skills

Python | Generative AI | LLM | RAG | Prompt Engineering | AI Agents | LangChain | LangGraph | OpenAI | Azure OpenAI | Embeddings | Vector Databases | Semantic Search | NLP | FastAPI | REST APIs | SQL | Azure | AWS | Docker | Git | LLM Evaluation | Responsible AI

5+ years of professional experience in software development with 1+ years in a leadership or mentoring capacity.

2+ years of experience in React and Node.js (or equivalent full-stack technologies).

Expert-level knowledge of architectural principles, design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.

Advanced knowledge of relational and non-relational databases

Strong understanding of architectural principles, design patterns, data structures, and algorithms.

Experience with both relational and NoSQL databases.

Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code quality best practices.

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native application development.

Exposure to AI-assisted feature development or willingness to work on GenAI components.

Experience working in agile teams.

Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Customer-oriented mindset with a passion for building modern, intelligent applications.

Bachelor s in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

Proficiency in one or more languages: Python, Golang, Java

Experience with SaaS products

Experience with AWS techs like EC2, EBS, S3, SNS, RDS, Lambda, and Faregate

Experience with containerization such as Docker, Kubernetes

Experience with EHR integration, Redox, FHIR, HL7

Benefits and perks:

We believe our people are our greatest strength. And with perks and benefits, we intend to offer everything our people need to do their best while maintaining a healthy balance between work and personal life.

Hybrid work: Flexibility to work from office or home

Support for resources: Get internet allowance monthly, and request resources for convenient WFH

5-day workweek: Take the weekend off and come back refreshed on Monday

Work/Life Balance

Paid time-offs: Annual, sick, compensation, and bereavement leaves

Maternity leave: 6 months of paid leave, 1 month of unpaid leave, and 90 days of reduced workload

Paternity leave: 15 days of paid paternity leave and reduced workload after

Menstruation leave: 6 days of paid menstruation leave annually

Celebrating your efforts

Engagement and Events: Team lunch/dinner, company outing, and festival celebrations with your favorite co-workers!

Exposure: Visit and work in the States and build better client rapport.

Recognition: In-house awards, appreciation platforms, and 5th-anniversary gifts!
